news.title:
Wealth First Portfolio Managers Ltd's subsidiary, Lakshya Asset Management, received SEBI approval to act as an AMC.
The final license allows Lakshya Asset Management to launch and manage mutual funds starting March 25, 2026.
Wealth First Portfolio Managers Ltd's unit secures SEBI mutual fund license.
Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹36.29 (vs ₹32.05 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹36.29 (up from ₹32.05 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹710.6m (up 19% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹386.6m (up 13% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 54% (down from 57% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 13% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 50% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Wealth First Portfolio Managers Limited Recommends Final Dividend for the Financial Year Ended on March 31, 2026
news.body:
Subject to the approval by the Members of the Company at the ensuing 24th Annual General Meeting, the Board of Directors of Wealth First Portfolio Managers Limited has considered and recommended Final Dividend @ 10% i.e. INR 1.00/- per Equity Share of Face Value of INR 10/- each for the financial year ended on March 31, 2026 on 106,55,000 Equity Shares.
Further, please note that the said Final Dividend is subject to deduction/withholding of applicable taxes and the
Dividend Warrants and the Dividend, if approved in the ensuing 24th Annual General Meeting shall be
credited/dispatched to Shareholders entitled thereto, within 30 days from the date of declaration of Dividend
i.e. date of ensuing 24th Annual General Meeting as provided in the Companies Act, 2013.

news.title: New minor risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$100m. Market cap: ₹9.57b (US$99.3m) This is considered a minor risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.72 (vs ₹8.70 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.72 (down from ₹8.70 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹67.6m (down 61% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹7.68m (down 92% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 11% (down from 54% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 18% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 35% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Second quarter dividend of ₹4.00 announced
news.body: Shareholders will receive a dividend of ₹4.00. Ex-date: 10th February 2026 Payment date: 6th March 2026 Dividend yield will be 1.9%, which is higher than the industry average of 1.3%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by both earnings (40% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (60% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 45% per year over the past 8 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. Earnings per share has grown by 28% over the last 5 years. Unless this trend reverses, it should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.
